notes: CGSS2017 nationally representative mainland-China household survey. Observed-only crosswalk at scripts/crosswalks/cgss.py maps 44 schema dims (demographics, family/life events, employment/career, media/internet, attitudes). All question numbers verified against the actual CGSS2017 .dta: a2 sex, a31 birth year (NOT a3a), a4 ethnicity, a7a education, a69 marital, a51-a521 religion multi-select, a6 attendance, a15 health, v458 trust, a43e SES, a301-a3012 leisure, a29 media, a30c news minutes, a30g/h mobile payment, a53/a54/a59a-e-f-j-l employment, c32/c34/c491-c4911/c58/c621-c625 attitudes, d131/d161-d164/d202/d381-d386/d61a/d62a/d3a-c-e/d4/d5a-b family. 12,582 respondents extracted (44 dims, avg 29.3 grounded dims/persona; validate_extraction.py: 0 errors). Faithfulness: non-Han ethnicity, 'graduate and above' education, hukou, party membership, mortgage-vs-ownoutright, and fabricated frequency->duration mappings (a284->streaming hours, a30c->screen time, a301/a302->interest) deliberately left null/unmapped.
